messages:
Priya (VP Infra): short follow-up from today's all-hands infra segment — starting this compact Q&A for GPU supply, regional buffers, and autoscale behavior. keep Qs short.

Maya (PM): are warm pools kept 24/7 or scaled by time-of-day for cost savings?

Priya (VP Infra): v1: tiny per-zone reserve (2 nodes) kept warm in critical APAC/EMEA zones; non-critical zones may use time-of-day policies to reduce cost.

Arjun (Capacity): adding that warm pools are paired with burst credits and a regional reserve; sequence on spike: burst credits -> warm-pool -> reprovision -> cross-region fallback.

Rosa (SRE): when fallback occurs, what latency uplift do we tell support to expect?

Priya (VP Infra): safe guidance: expect +45 to +150ms depending on region pair. recommend Dedicated pinning for strict latency guarantees.

Tom (Platform): priming jobs caused autoscale noise yesterday. can priming be exempted from triggers?

Arjun (Capacity): yes  we will tag priming traffic and ignore it up to a soft threshold (5% of cluster capacity) and add a short smoothing window to avoid flapping.

Maya (PM): H100 timing for Dedicated? customers ask about demos.

Priya (VP Infra): partners expect initial H100 capacity next quarter; Dedicated opt-in ~4 weeks after arrival post-safety checks. Product will run a small pilot cohort first.

Rosa (SRE): actions I need: dashboard annotation for priming windows.

Arjun (Capacity): noted  will add annotation and the priming tag this sprint.

Priya (VP Infra): ACTIONS: 1) Arjun: priming tag + dashboard annotation. 2) Tom: cost sims (warm vs on-demand) by Friday. 3) Priya: publish model-eligibility blurb this week. will fold into all-hands notes.

Maya (PM): thanks, this helps.

Priya (VP Infra): thanks all  small follow-ups here; larger asks via #eng-oncall or an RFC. closing when actions are tracked.
